career_ladder.note: Qualifying MAHA TET is a statutory requirement under Section 23 of the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009 for appointment as primary and upper primary teachers in Zilla Parishad, Municipal Corporation, and government-aided schools across Maharashtra. Candidate appointment is executed via the Pavitra Portal through the Teacher Aptitude and Intelligence Test (TAIT). Career advancement operates under Maharashtra Civil Services rules with time-bound Assured Career Progression (Senior Scale at 12 years, Selection Grade at 24 years).

exam_scheme.note: Conducted as an offline pen-and-paper OMR-based test by the Maharashtra State Council of Examination (MSCE), Pune in 9 official question paper media (Marathi, English, Urdu, Hindi, Gujarati, Telugu, Sindhi, Kannada, and Bengali). Consists of two independent papers: Paper I for Primary Teachers (Classes I–V) and Paper II for Upper Primary Teachers (Classes VI–VIII). Both papers comprise 150 objective multiple-choice questions for 150 marks over 150 minutes (2 hours 30 minutes). There is no negative marking. Qualifying threshold is 60% (90/150) for Open category and 55% (83/150) for reserved categories. Certificates have lifetime validity.

financial_package.note: Primary and secondary teachers appointed in Maharashtra local body (Zilla Parishad / Municipal Corporation) and aided private schools upon qualifying MAHA TET and TAIT are compensated under Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2019, strictly distinct from Central 7th CPC structures.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2019, Schedule (Primary Teacher Entry Scale S-10)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level S-10 entry basic pay of ₹29,200 with 58% DA (₹16,936 effective 01.07.2025), HRA (9% to 27% depending on rural/urban classification: ₹2,628 to ₹7,884), Transport Allowance, net of NPS/DCPS deduction (10% of Basic + DA = ₹4,614) and profession tax (₹200).
official_perks: Retirement security under Defined Contributory Pension Scheme (DCPS/NPS)
Gratuity and State Group Insurance Scheme (GIS) benefits
Medical reimbursement coverage under Maharashtra State Government rules
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) once in 4-year block
Long vacation entitlements (summer, diwali, and mid-term school vacations)
Statutory maternity, paternity, medical, and casual leave allowances
